findings.summary: D8 conflicts do not stop recovery and cancellation: recovery persists an APPROVED action as BLOCKED, then attempts FAILED->FAILED, so blocked_action_ids is never recorded and reconstruction disagrees with the row; cancel continues with a stale revision.
Fallback turns write no turn marker, so after consecutive fallbacks a successful assembly clears reads returned on the last fallback turn before the model consumed them.
context.assembled keeps drop counts only, so the drop log ADR 0032 §13 requires in the evidence bundle cannot be recovered.
context.assembled is a sound minimal turn marker but is absent from ADR 0032 §11; document payload and timing.
